svg.title: Nested time limits: the client's wait, the request's budget, and the calls inside it
svg.desc: The client waits up to 10 seconds. Inside that, Roombook gives the request a 2 second budget that ends at a deadline. The Redis read may take half a second at most, and the query after it gets only the time left before the deadline. A fresh 2 second timeout for the query would run past the deadline.
svg.text: The client waits up to 10 s
a fresh 2 s runs past it
